note: What a game will and will not accept back — from a model, and from a person typing in an editor. The error lines are not for a log: a model receives them verbatim on its next attempt, so their wording is behaviour and is frozen here. Line breaks inside a message are \n.

frozen_sequences.out: list: each placeholder with the delimiters the game wrapped around it, once each, in order of first appearance

accepts.out: {accepted: bool, errors: [string]} — the strict gate for a MODEL's answer, brackets over the whole text included

accepts_edit.out: {accepted: bool, errors: [string]} — the gate for a PERSON's edit: the same placeholder rule, without the bracket count

repair_trailing_breaks.out: the translation with the missing trailing [!nl] appended, or null when the repair does not apply

mandatory_sequences.out: the last attempt's extra instructions, verbatim

tokens.out: list: every placeholder in order, repeats included

invented.out: list: the tokens the answer carries that the source never had, once each

tally.out: object: token → how many times it appears

max_attempts.out: int: how many times a text is sent before it is left untranslated

cases.why: a bare token is frozen as itself: nothing around it to keep
keeping the token and losing the bracket still breaks the line

the parenthesis wraps a phrase, not the token, and the phrase moves with the language — « coupe-boulons (Promo [!v*0]) » is right; freezing the single side refused every such translation (seen 2026-09-12)
a wrap is a pair; a bracket with no answer on the other side belongs to the text around it
it is a list of what must appear, not a tally
expanding only over opening then closing characters cannot cross a token
a text without placeholders freezes nothing and needs no validation at all
nothing in, nothing out
same tokens, same brackets

errors: the exact sequence "[!v*1]" is missing or altered

cases.why: the game would substitute nothing — and the refusal names the token, because this text is handed to the model, not written in a log
it would appear twice in game

errors: the exact sequence "[!v*0]" is missing or altered
token [!v*7] does not exist in the source

cases.why: the game has no seventh value to put there
the case that makes containment insufficient: "[{[!v*0]}]" contains "[!v*0]" and is still wrong

errors: token [!STR*9] does not exist in the source

cases.why: the strict gate says what Invented says, in its own words: its lines go to the model on the next attempt, so they name the token
a model gets refused for a bracket of its own: there is nobody to ask what it meant, and wrapping text in brackets is how a placeholder gets buried
what the trailing-break repair produces is accepted, otherwise it would cost an attempt for nothing
the token is there once, as in the source; where the sentence puts it is the language's business, not the rule's
the ordinary case, and the one everything else is measured against

errors: the exact sequence "[!v*0]" is missing or altered

cases.why: the game substitutes at runtime and would show a level with no number
the same value written twice is not the same line — accepted from a person and refused from a model until 2026-09-08

errors: the exact sequence "({[!v*0]})" is missing or altered

cases.why: the token survives and the line still breaks — which is why frozen sequences are checked as sequences

errors: token [!STR*0] does not exist in the source

cases.why: a token the source never had substitutes to nothing anybody wrote
the check a person is NOT held to: it is not a placeholder, it breaks nothing, and refusing it would make the editor argue with its user
there is nothing to keep, so there is nothing to refuse
nothing to keep

an empty edit is not a translation: the game shows its source and substitutes nothing, so there is no placeholder to keep. The mod never stores one (SetTranslationFromEditor returns on empty); the site keeps the line as a capture. Refusing it made an untranslated line open on every marker 'missing' before a word was typed
models tidy trailing line breaks away, every single time: a credits roll of 51 came back with 50 on every launch
the break goes at the very end, after whatever whitespace the model left there
a break lost in the middle is a different sentence, and nobody wrote it
no deficit, no repair
only ever appends: an extra break is not repaired
an empty answer is no answer; appending a break to it would make one up

cases.why: the last attempt starts fresh, with nothing left implicit
the four families, in order, repeats included — one pattern, written once, so a token form added tomorrow is added everywhere
only the four forms are placeholders; anything that merely looks like one is text
nothing in, nothing out
asked where Accepts is not: the source has no placeholder, so nothing else checks this answer — a bare [!STR*0] went on screen and was shared with everyone
keeping a placeholder is the whole point; flagging it would refuse every correct answer
slot 1 is not slot 0: put back, it would show a value that belongs elsewhere
the list goes into a sentence a person reads, not into a tally
the overwhelming majority, which must cost nothing to establish
nothing invents nothing
nor does no answer at all
how many times each placeholder appears — the multiset the gate compares
nothing to count
plain, corrected, then restated — the shape matters as much as the number
